Model-visible description text of the wrapped custom-tool input field and the heading that prefixes the embedded original tool definition.

adaptedBehavior: Function tool schemas are passed through after normalizing parameters.type to "object", as upstream does for strict OpenAI-compatible providers.
Custom tool declarations embed the canonical JSON of the original Responses declaration in the Chat function description, and calls wrap the freeform input as {"input": <string>}.
Chat tool names are flattened as {namespace}__{name} and capped at 64 bytes with a SHA-256 suffix; the origin map restores the original namespace.
deliberateDivergences: Colliding or empty Chat tool names fail closed instead of being dropped silently (first declaration wins upstream), so no tool disappears without a typed error.
Opaque-only reasoning (encrypted_content without readable text) fails closed instead of being dropped silently.
No fabricated "tool call" reasoning placeholder is inserted; providers that reject an assistant tool-call turn without reasoning_content surface a classified upstream error.
The incomplete-frame carry buffer is bounded, while the upstream carry grows until a delimiter arrives.
Compaction-trigger requests are rejected before the upstream send because compaction stays local to Codex in this release.
notes: Only short model-visible literals and their structure were reproduced; no upstream source file is redistributed in this repository.
